entities.name: Azar
entities.description: Wizard from Shandalar, apprentice of Kenan Sahrmal, whose body was taken over by Lim-Dul.

entities.name: Kenan Sahrmal
entities.description: Wizard who took Azar and the Guardian as apprentices and buried Azar's body.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: Necromancer whose soul seized Azar's body and later started the Wizards' War.

entities.name: Lim-Dul's War
entities.description: War during which Azar fought Lim-Dul.

entities.name: Wizards' War
entities.description: War started when Lim-Dul rose from the grave.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Artifact used to power the Great Barrier of Shandalar, in which Lim-Dul was imprisoned.

entities.name: Skavius Slan
entities.description: Immortal lich lord, the soulless body of Azar, who commanded the Black Guild.

entities.name: Arzakon's War
entities.description: War in which Skavius Slan was destroyed.

events.summary: Azar destroys Lim-Dul's body, but Lim-Dul takes control of Azar's body and the two souls are trapped together.
events.quote: Lim-Dûl was prepared for this and managed to take control of Azar's body.

events.summary: Sahrmal quietly buries the rigid body in a necropolis.
events.quote: so Sahrmal quietly buried it in a necropolis.

events.summary: Lim-Dul wins the battle of souls, banishes Azar, rises from the grave and starts the Wizards' War.
events.quote: Lim-Dûl won the battle of souls, banishing Azar from his body

events.summary: Lim-Dul is defeated and imprisoned in the Chain Veil.
events.quote: he was eventually defeated and imprisoned in the Chain Veil

events.summary: Azar's soulless body rises on its own as Skavius Slan and takes command of the Black Guild.
events.quote: It rose on its own and took the name Skavius Slan

events.summary: Skavius Slan is destroyed in Arzakon's War, ending Azar's haunted body.
events.quote: Skavius Slan was destroyed and Azar's long haunted body finally came to an end.

relations.quote: Azar was an apprentice of Kenan Sahrmal

relations.note: Azar fought Lim-Dul and was displaced by him.
Took command of the Black Guild.
relations.quote: Then it took command of the Black Guild
